cache_observation: Cold and strict-PWN/manifold-warmed outputs have the same local receipts and bytes. Stronger geometry validation is allowed; it does not prove the original hull relation.
classification: Verified missing end-to-end construction evidence; later operation-local topology certificates are valid for their stated claims.
decision: Retain the reproduced counterexample and use it as a non-negotiable acceptance case for construction-evidence work. Do not fix this by downgrading valid strict topology proofs, changing policies, increasing the modeling refinement budget, or deleting the source point.
failed_attempts: Probe v1 failed to compile because Point3 has no dot/cross methods. V2 uses the same signed tetrahedral volume expanded as a coordinate determinant; the original source and failed compiler output remain retained.
limitations: This is a finite diagnostic, not a production repair, exhaustive provenance audit or proof of every public entry point.
Box plane/volume checks and native topology checks support the observed geometry; the corpus here is focused on receipt scope, not a new universal independent mesh oracle.
The 1400-bit point proof is diagnostic evidence obtained after pipeline completion; it is not credited to any earlier local operation.
No whole-history artifact recovery, internal resource bound, binding runtime or shipped-distribution claim is made.

source_intent_counterexample.mathematical_argument: The hull of [0,1]^3 with this point adds a pyramid whose base is the unit square at x=0 and whose altitude is 2^-1200. Its volume is 2^-1200/3 > 0. Translation and union with the face-adjacent unit cube preserve this missing positive volume before format projection.
source_intent_counterexample.observed_output: The approximate hull is the unexpanded cube, and the union has exact volume two. Every output vertex is bounded by the expected box and every facet lies on its outer planes; strict PWN and manifold checks pass.
source_intent_counterexample.qualification: Approximate policy consumption is reported correctly by the hull. The defect is missing construction provenance downstream, not an alleged false local topology certificate or a claim that approximate policy must compute the exact original hull.

crates/hypermesh/src/context.rs.finding: CertaintyFact can strengthen a proof of an unchanged fact; DecisionContext certainty is operation-local. Neither claims the original hull-point-set relation.

crates/hypermesh/src/convex_hull.rs.finding: The hull returns its local receipt and records valid-PWN certainty on the resulting mesh. Interior/duplicate source points are not present in the compact hull output.

crates/hypermesh/src/mesh.rs.finding: TriangleMesh retains geometry-bound PWN and construction-plane facts, but no separate end-to-end construction qualification. Mutation invalidates cached geometry facts through buffer identity.

crates/hypermesh/src/mesh/concatenation..finding: Concatenation preserves known PWN certainty, a different claim from provenance of the supplied geometry.

crates/hypermesh/src/output.rs.finding: Boolean batch materialization creates bare native meshes and explicitly discards triangle-source provenance. This conversion must participate in a future construction-evidence design.

src/context.rs.finding: GeometryOutcome holds the local value and certainty; map preserves that receipt, but into_value returns only T. GeometryDecisions starts each operation with Certified and observes facts consumed inside it.

src/io/stl.rs.finding: Binary STL projects to binary32 and validates nondegenerate projected triangles. Import returns a new mesh after strict closed-PWN validation; neither plain bytes nor this return type binds an earlier exact-source claim.

src/solid.rs.finding: Transform and Boolean entry points take bare TriangleMesh inputs. Each constructs new local GeometryDecisions. The canonical-empty bridge uses native validation and regularization; it cannot recover earlier intent from an absent construction receipt.

src/wasm/curve_js.rs.finding: GeometryMeshResultJs stores its local receipt separately; intoMesh retains only its TriangleMesh. This was source-reviewed, not executed by a JavaScript consumer in this observation.

src/wasm/mesh_js.rs.finding: MeshJs stores the native mesh, making the native carrier the shared place to retain construction evidence.

validation_scope: Current root library built by Cargo with stl-io only; one corrected probe compile and eight fresh pipelines, followed by the expanded final probe compile and twelve fresh pipelines. The original eight stdout rows and STL hashes match exactly. No production source edit or broad CI/runtime/binding rerun.
